name: voice-room
description: Simple link-based LiveKit voice chat with screen sharing.

scripts.dev:restart: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart api web
scripts.check: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run check
scripts.test: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run test
scripts.coverage:g08: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('coverage/.release-250-v8',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('coverage/.release-250-v8',{recursive:true})" && G08_V8_DIR=coverage/.release-250-v8 NODE_V8_COVERAGE=coverage/.release-250-v8 node --test scripts/test/g08-coverage-gate.test.mjs packages/shared/test/validation.test.js packages/shared/test/realtime.test.js apps/api/test/rate-limit.test.js apps/api/test/pow.test.js apps/api/test/push-endpoint.test.js apps/api/test/config.test.js apps/api/test/password.test.js apps/api/test/avatar-processing.test.js apps/api/test/avatar-storage.test.js apps/api/test/push-service.test.js apps/api/test/user-store-unit.test.js apps/api/test/g05-livekit-boundary.test.js && node scripts/coverage/check-release-250-coverage.mjs --v8-dir coverage/.release-250-v8 --out coverage/release-250-summary.json
